_note: Ben, 8 Oct: one plain note per film on the Studio Kanban. Done so far / The holdup / Second limit / Next (who, what, when) / For you. Claude keeps these current on every hourly studio run; the page shows each note's 'updated' time and flags it if it is over a day old. Steps with 'job' take their times live from the job queue; 'afterJob' + 'lag' (minutes) means 'that long after the job is done'. 'when' is an ISO date or time; 'whenText' says it in words when there is no fixed time. 'mood' picks the column: good or held = In progress, waiting = To do, finished or ready = Done. 'line' is the one plain sentence on the card. A step's 'kind' (scripts/routing.py: script, facts, review, vo, image, chart, video, assembly, qa, listing, studio, chief) sets who it shows for a step still to do: the routed worker (Ben, 12 Oct), or whoever holds its job; done steps keep their doer. 'you' is empty when there is nothing for Ben. 'uatFolderUrl' (top level) is Ben's iCloud share link to the OWB UAT folder (icloud.com links only); a film's 'uatUrl' is a share link to its own file, if Ben ever makes one.
